reason: It's brand new with zero reviews, and I don't try tools I can't read about. I'd poke at the free tier on our site, but 15 pages desktop-only won't show me whether it holds up on a real 200-page site, and I only need full-site captures a few times a year anyway.
objection: No reviews and no proof it handles real sites, especially ours with a login and some bot protection. Paying monthly for something I use quarterly feels like waste.
would_change_my_mind: Solid independent reviews plus a free trial of the full multi-device capture on my own site, or a one-off pay-per-capture option instead of a subscription.
